tagline: Diversified industrial technology provider serving HVAC, detection, measurement and infrastructure markets
hero_kpi_rationale: Robust 14% growth driven by strategic acquisitions (KTS, Sigma Omega, Ingenia) and organic growth in HVAC and Detection and Measurement segments

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue of the company, including revenues from HVAC and Detection and Measurement segments, including post-acquisition contributions
kpis.signal: Revenue increase due to organic growth and strategic acquisitions (KTS, Sigma Omega, Ingenia)

kpis.name: Operating Profit
kpis.description: Operating profit of the company, including profits from HVAC and Detection and Measurement segments, before taxes and financial expenses
kpis.signal: Operating profit increase driven by revenue growth and control of operating costs despite pricing pressures

kpis.name: Total Revenue 2025
kpis.explanation: Total revenue of the company in 2025
kpis.description: Total revenue of the company in 2025, including full contributions from HVAC and Detection and Measurement segments as well as integrated acquisitions
kpis.signal: Growth sustained by strategic acquisitions (KTS $340M, Sigma Omega $143.3M, Ingenia $292M) and organic growth

risks.title: Economic and industrial cycles affecting demand
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned first in the 10-K and described as having a recurring impact on revenues. The language emphasizes the possibility of materially adverse effects. Fluctuations in demand for data centers and infrastructure investments illustrate cyclical exposure.

risks.title: Dependence on customer investments and public funding
risks.score_rationale: Positioned early in the document, this risk is described as potentially affecting the financial condition materially. The strength of the language (material adverse effect) and dependence on key external factors (credit, public budgets) reinforce its severity. Capital category heavily weighted in a context of budgetary uncertainty.

risks.title: Increased competition and margin pressure
risks.score_rationale: The risk is detailed with emphasis on margin pressure and potential loss of market share. The language highlights impact on profitability and ability to maintain or grow market share. Competition category moderately weighted but the scale of threats justifies high severity.

risks.title: Volatility in prices and shortages of raw materials
risks.score_rationale: This risk is repeated multiple times with mention of significant fluctuations and material impact on results. The link to pricing, supply chains, and inability to pass through costs increases its severity. Announced price increases in 2025 illustrate this growing exposure.

risks.title: Execution of fixed-price contracts and cost overrun risks
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly highlights the risk of project losses if costs are underestimated. The connection to revenue recognition and contractual penalties strengthens the financial impact. Credit category rated high due to risk of asset impairment and loss of profitability.

risks.title: Risks related to government contracts and public funding
risks.score_rationale: The risk is detailed across several paragraphs with mention of suspension, sanctions, or cancellation. The language is strong (could bar us from bidding). The Regulation category is moderately weighted, but dependence on public budgets increases exposure.

risks.title: Operational disruptions from unforeseen events
risks.score_rationale: The risk includes pandemics, natural disasters, cyberattacks, and other unforeseen events. The document explicitly cites the COVID-19 experience. The Industrial category is impacted by geographic dependence on production sites and critical suppliers.

risks.title: Acquisition integration difficulties
risks.score_rationale: The risk is well developed with mention of impairment, additional debt, and internal control weaknesses. The document acknowledges that due diligence does not guarantee discovery of all hidden risks. Capital category rated high in the context of intensive external growth (3 acquisitions in 2024-2025).

ai_positioning.summary: SPXC does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 2025 10-K filing. The document contains no reference to AI-related initiatives, investments, or applications within its HVAC, Detection and Measurement, or Communication Technologies operations.
